resources.string: Editing a message — sending will replace the rest
No network connection: check Wi-Fi or mobile data, then send the message again.
Cannot reach the server (network error). Check your Internet connection and try again.
Cannot resolve the server address (DNS): check your Internet connection or the server address.
Secure connection failed (TLS): the server certificate is invalid or blocked.
Local server unreachable (%1$s): make sure it is running and the phone is on the same network.
API key refused (401): check the key in Settings › Providers.
Forbidden (403): this account has no access to this model.
Resource not found (404): invalid model or server address.
Stream interrupted mid-answer — received content is kept and flagged.
Empty response from the model — try again or rephrase the request.
Context exceeded: the conversation is too long — compact the history or start a new conversation.
The model reached its token limit — response truncated.
Invalid server address: use a full http(s):// URL.
Tool loop detected — the agent stopped.
No API key for “%1$s” — add it in Settings › Providers.
Access denied to %1$s (file permissions or Android).
Disk full — free some space (trash, caches) and try again.
Binary file or invalid encoding — cannot read as text.
Already exists: %1$s — rename it or choose another destination.
Storage permission revoked by Android — reopen the folder from the app.
Suspicious archive (Zip Slip): entry outside the destination.
Cannot prepare the terminal: %1$s — check free disk space and retry.
Invalid downloaded package — try again or switch mirror.
Notifications refused: enable them in Android settings to follow the agent.
Microphone unavailable: allow it in Settings › Permissions.
Daily budget exceeded (%1$d / %2$d tokens) — raise the limit or wait until tomorrow.
Step limit of %1$d reached for this request.
The app restarted after a crash — Help › Report a problem to share the report.
Unreadable conversation — isolated into corrupted files so others keep working.
Pre-migration backup kept in %1$s before any transformation.
Agent tool failures, network errors and crashes will appear here, timestamped and filterable.
Journal trimmed to the 200 most recent entries — refine with a filter or a search.
Builds a diagnostic report (version, device, last crash, recent activity) and shares it. No API key or conversation content included.
Report a problem or suggest an idea
Daily budget exceeded — alert (changeable in Settings).
The agent asks to delete this item from the project. This action is permanent.
Tip: type “@” then a few letters of the name: autocomplete suggests the project\'s files.
Tip: the model chip in the input bar changes the current conversation\'s model only. Stars pin your models at the top of the picker.
Tip: save the gateway in Settings › AI providers with its own key — its models will show up here automatically.
No pinned messages. Open a message\'s menu then “Pin”.
The block content will replace the whole file (the file is created if missing). Path relative to the project.
The agent\'s future writes to this file will be automatic.
The content is converted to Markdown, ready to review or archive.
Offline — chat waits for the network (tap to retry). Editor and terminal remain usable.
Plan mode: the agent proposes a plan and waits for your approval before writing (/plan to turn off)
This choice only applies to this conversation and reverts to the global setting with “New conversation”.
The content is attached to the agent\'s context along with your message.
Write a message to the model…
No paths yet. When the agent proposes a write, choose “Always allow” to add it here.
A and B alternate aloud, two turns each, then wrap up. Write your topic to start the debate.
The model chosen above (A) does the task, then model B reviews its reply and suggests fixes.
The agent reads the project, suggests a fix and applies it after your confirmation.
Selected folders and all their content will be deleted.
Tap a branch to switch to it (uncommitted changes must be compatible). The trash icon deletes a local branch.
Paste a https://github.com/… URL; a token can be saved in Settings for a private repo.
Used to clone private repos, push/pull and create pull requests. Stored encrypted, never sent to models.
From the current branch to the repo default branch. Requires a GitHub token (Settings).
No SSH key. Generate an ed25519 pair then add the public key in GitHub › Settings › SSH keys to clone/push without a token.
Frosted floating glass on bars and sheets. Adjustable in Appearance.
Light and dark settings will be restored.
Tint applied only to floating surfaces
Tag the conversation (e.g. “work”, “project X”). Empty = no folder.
Your conversations will appear here, grouped by day.
e.g.: reply in French, use TypeScript, no useless comments…
One tap replaces the global text with the chosen model\'s.
They take precedence over the global text for this project.
No models: add a key in Settings › Providers.
The agent only accesses the active project. Import a phone folder to start, or create a project later from the Projects screen.
Choose a phone folder for this project.
README, HTML page and Python script, ready to edit
Pick your provider and paste its key — auto-detected (nvapi- = NVIDIA). Everything can change later in Settings › Providers.
A coding agent that reads, creates and edits your project\'s files, straight from your phone. Describe a task, it handles the rest.
The file is empty — write Markdown on the left, the preview updates live.
Open the page in your usual browser
Blocks everything: writes, deletions and commands. The agent can only read and analyze.
Shell commands without confirmation (git push, commit and destructive commands still ask).
The agent runs everything without confirmation (git push, commit and destructive commands still ask).
Fine-grained: each agent tool can be always allowed, left as ask, or blocked.
The agent can explore and read the project.
New files and light edits without confirmation; overwrites and deletions confirmed.
New files and small edits without confirmation; overwrite and delete confirmed
The agent can search the web (DuckDuckGo) and read pages with fetch_url for documentation.
An alert appears when today\'s usage exceeds this cap (0 = no budget).
OpenRouter, Groq, local Ollama, LM Studio… any OpenAI-style endpoint
Exports the configuration WITHOUT keys (model, appearance, agent, security) to share or restore.
HTTPS required (except localhost/192.168.x/10.x): fix the URL or use a local gateway.
Paste JSON exported from another install. Any API keys are ignored.
Max steps per request, then a Continue button
On overload or rejected key, switches by itself to an available model (turn off to stay on your model).
NVIDIA NIM and other providers: Settings › Models. Each API key travels with its models (upd. 101).
Captures the current model, auto mode, smart mode, budget and steps.
Save the current model and agent settings under a name (e.g. “work”) to recall them in one tap.
Each template creates the initial tree in a new project, then automatically sends a first message to the agent.
The terminal needs to download its system (once only).
Black background and deep surfaces in dark mode
Limited access to the chosen folder
No known folder — expand the tree first.
The editor keeps its night background and tuned palette; off, code follows the light theme.
Items are kept for 7 days, then deleted automatically.
Changes apply immediately across the whole app.
The chosen size adds to Android\'s (Settings › Display › Font size).
Menus, sliders, send and task end
“System” follows Android\'s language. The change applies immediately.
Pinch the code area or drag this slider (10 to 22 sp).
Pinch the terminal screen or drag this slider (10 to 22 sp).
All appearance settings will be restored: theme, presets, accents, light and dark glass, OLED, system colors, radii and schedules. API keys and projects are untouched.
Tap a bar for the day\'s details.
No usable message in the file
A file already has this name.
Save or close modified tabs before renaming.
Save or close modified tabs before deleting.
Copy created at %1$s but deleting the source failed: %2$s
The zip is empty or invalid.
Tip: type “@” then a few letters of the name: autocomplete suggests the project\'s files. The quoted file\'s content is attached to the message.
No app can open this file: %1$s
Error: tool loop detected — 3 identical consecutive calls to %1$s. Stop this approach and suggest another one.
Export failed: no project open or write error.
Daily budget exceeded (%1$d / %2$d tokens). You can keep going, but consider adjusting the budget in Settings.
Compare: choose model B (model menu, Duo mode section).
Duo mode: choose a second model with an API key set.
“%1$s” belongs to provider “%2$s”, currently disabled. Re-enable it in Settings › Providers.
Invalid branch name: letters, digits, . _ / - only.
The main branch cannot be deleted from the app.
First set a GitHub token in Settings › GitHub.
Give the pull request a title.
Invalid URL: must start with https:// or git@.
The previous project folder no longer exists — select a new project.
Settings reset after restore — re-enter your API keys in Settings › Providers.
Nothing to compact (history too short or no summary available).
SSH key generated — copy the public key into GitHub › Settings › SSH keys.
Context compacted: older history has been summarized.
Message queued (%1$d waiting) — will send after the current turn.
Offline — message queued (%1$d waiting). It will send once the network is back.
Cloning… (large repos may take a while)
Message cancelled before the agent\'s first reply.
No repository connected. Connect a GitHub repository: it will be fully cloned and the agent can work on it even offline.
Local work is kept — sync will resume once the network is back.
The full repository (entire history) will be cloned into a new project, which becomes the agent\'s working environment — usable even offline.
No repository listed (token missing or empty). Paste a github.com URL:
Environment connected: %1$s → project “%2$s”. The agent can now work on it, even offline.
Offline: nothing was sent, nothing was lost. Sync will resume once the network is back.
Environment already up to date with GitHub.
%1$d commit(s) fetched, %2$d pushed — environment up to date.
Conflicts detected during the pull — resolve them, commit, then run the sync again.
No environment connected — use env_connect (“owner/repo”) to fully clone a repository.
Environment: %1$s, branch %2$s. %3$s; %4$s; %5$d uncommitted changed file(s); %6$d conflict(s). %7$s
Currently offline: all local work remains possible.
%1$d orphaned conversation(s) recovered and re-added to history.
Pick the conversation to merge into this one; its content is appended, the other thread goes to the trash.
The AI only accesses aliases: it inserts {{secret:alias}} into commands and the real value is substituted at execution time, never shown.
Re-ask PIN before using keys after 24 h
PIN validated: key access unlocked for 24 h.
Comma-separated domains (e.g. github.com, api.openai.com). Empty = all allowed. Subdomains included.
Any token-like value (github_pat_, ghp_, sk-…, Bearer …) is masked before being sent to the model.
A GitHub request returned 401: the token is probably revoked or expired. Generate a new fine-grained PAT on GitHub then paste it in Settings › GitHub.
Off-catalog model: unknown cost and limits — check spelling or provider.
Key session expired: re-enter your PIN in Permissions & security to continue.
The last turn was interrupted: tool locks released on restart.
Review: validate or cancel your message above before sending.
Your message shows Validate / Cancel buttons before going to the model.
Duo mode refused: model %1$s has no configured key — set that provider key first.
Provider quota exceeded for %1$s: %2$.2f € / %3$.2f € this month. Raise the quota or switch provider.
Project snippets — tap to insert into the input, long-press to save the current command.
Save current command as a snippet
